attribute.combat_attributes.melee_crit_c: Chance for a melee attack to land a critical strike.
attribute.combat_attributes.melee_crit_d: Damage multiplier applied on a melee critical strike.
attribute.combat_attributes.ranged_damag: Flat damage added to non-magic projectile attacks.
attribute.combat_attributes.ranged_crit_: Chance for a projectile attack to land a critical strike.
Damage multiplier applied on a ranged critical strike.
attribute.combat_attributes.magic_crit_c: Chance for a magic attack to land a critical strike.
attribute.combat_attributes.magic_crit_d: Damage multiplier applied on a magic critical strike.
Magic damage multiplier — analog to attack damage for magic. Read by spell mods.
attribute.combat_attributes.evasion.desc: Chance to dodge incoming damage of any source.
attribute.combat_attributes.lifesteal.de: Fraction of any damage dealt within attack range that heals the attacker.
attribute.combat_attributes.magic_defens: Armor-style mitigation applied to incoming magic damage.
attribute.combat_attributes.health_regen: Health regenerated per second while below maximum.
attribute.combat_attributes.draw_speed.d: Speeds up bow draw time and crossbow charge time.
attribute.combat_attributes.arrow_veloci: Increases the launch speed of arrows fired from bows and crossbows.
attribute.combat_attributes.accuracy.des: Reduces spread of fired arrows; at maximum, removes all inaccuracy.
Maximum stamina pool. Stamina powers ability use.
attribute.combat_attributes.stamina_cost: Multiplier applied to stamina costs paid by abilities.
attribute.combat_attributes.max_mana.des: Maximum mana pool. Mana powers ability use.
attribute.combat_attributes.mana_cost.de: Multiplier applied to mana costs paid by abilities.
attribute.combat_attributes.experience_g: Multiplier on XP awarded to the player's XP bar from experience orbs.
